versions.subject: Updates + New Rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: 'reg.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'reg.exe'
selection_delete:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' delete '
        - '\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SafeBoot'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*reg.exe" OR OriginalFileName="reg.exe" CommandLine IN ("* delete *", "*\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SafeBoot*")

versions.subject: False positive fix, needs to match ALL of selectioN_delete, not 1 of them
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: 'reg.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'reg.exe'
selection_delete:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' delete '
        - '\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SafeBoot'
condition: all of selection*
